fmt.danger.zh: 格式化会清空该分区全部数据，且不可撤销。

parts.noRead.en: No read permission: enable All files access in Settings, then restart the app

parts.permTitle.zh: 需要「管理所有文件」权限

err.notFound.en: This tool build does not support that command

setup.flowBody.zh:
① 选/建盘（分区+格式化已包含）
② 释放系统映像（写引导、写 RE、引导检查都在这一步）
③ 全盘检查

释放会写入数据，中途别强退；检查是只读的，随时可退。
setup.flowBody.en:
1) Pick or create a disk (partitioning + formatting included)
2) Apply the Windows image (boot files, RE and boot check happen here)
3) Full disk check

Applying writes data — don't force-quit mid-way. The final check is read-only.

br.fw32.fail.en: Firmware extraction failed — the app's bundled assets are damaged, reinstall the app

br.fw32.how.zh:
1. 在上面的卡片里释放固件，再复制参数。
2. 打开虚拟机设置，把处理器架构改成 I386。
3. 关掉 UEFI 开关（32 位固件由参数接管）。
4. 把参数粘进「自定义 QEMU 参数」，保存后启动。

32 位固件只加载 32 位 .efi。64 位系统仍用启动器自带的 64 位固件，不要混用。
br.fw32.how.en:
1. Extract the firmware above, then copy the arguments.
2. Open the VM settings and set the CPU architecture to I386.
3. Turn the UEFI switch off (the 32-bit firmware is supplied by the arguments).
4. Paste the arguments into "Custom QEMU arguments", save, and boot.

The 32-bit firmware only loads 32-bit .efi files. 64-bit systems keep using the launcher's own 64-bit firmware — do not mix them.

br.healthy.body.zh:

br.healthy.body.en:
No boot problems were found. Rewrite the boot files anyway?

This overwrites the existing boot files and BCD. If you only wanted to check the status, just go back.

dep.bit32Warn.zh: 这是 32 位 Windows：GPT 盘要用 32 位 UEFI 固件才能启动，需要给虚拟机额外注入 pflash 参数（引导修复页会给你现成的）。32 位 UEFI 最低要求 Windows 8；Vista / Win7 的 32 位镜像没有 EFI 引导文件，写引导会失败。
dep.bit32Warn.en: This is 32-bit Windows: a GPT disk needs 32-bit UEFI firmware to boot, which requires extra pflash arguments for the VM (the boot-repair page gives you ready-made ones). 32-bit UEFI needs Windows 8 or later; Vista/Win7 32-bit images have no EFI boot files and the boot step will fail.
